correctness.rationale: For clique corona K_n with one private pendant leaf at each core vertex, n>=2, every new leaf bit equals the old hub bit. For a core state a, old leaf state b, hub i sees |a|-a_i+b_i ones among n neighbors. Even n collapses hub update to 0,b,1 according as |a| is below, at or above n/2; immediate periodic configurations are exactly ordered balanced core/leaf pairs, plus the two unanimities. Odd n four local pair-type inequalities imply that nonfixed immediate 2-cycles fall into exactly three disjoint families (one stationary 00 or 11 coordinate and r flips of each type; or all coordinates flip with weights r,r+1), giving P2=2n binom(n-1,r)+2binom(n,r). The symmetric threshold energy gives no eventual period greater than two. Independent full labelled enumeration at n=2..7 matched all P1,P2, corroborating the general proof.
